assertions: Create dispatches once; no Stop for an unconfigured workspace.
The exact service-preflight-v1 marker gates a running Change; an older connector gets no Stop or change.
Cancel is initially focused; Return cancels without an effect and returns focus to the submitter.
A confirmed Stop of the shown generation can drain without sending enrollment; the original join input remains only in the form.
The exact stopped identity permits a later explicit confirmation, without another Stop.
A saved pending result uses Check, not create or join; reopening the app reads that saved state without a credential.
An uncertain join clears its input, forces one status read despite a stale busy view, and exposes Check; no automatic enrollment replay.
Legacy local disconnect has its own confirmation.
Only saved migration-draining replies authorize bounded Check continuations; migration-blocked stops them.
